environment.package: local debug executable; not an extracted release

manual_sweep.scope: Initial visible viewport of each category; Audio Other and Interface sidebar scrolling also inspected. Not all lower sections, dialogs or behavioral combinations.
observed_fixes: General combo value and History labels readable on light panels.
Audio hardware/volume values and checkbox labels readable.
Preferences retains its intended width when height is limited; Show welcome window fits in full.
Audio Hardware, Volume and Other share one scroll page; section links reach Other with a full viewport background.
Audio sidebar exposes all categories; expanded Interface sidebar scrolls to Utilities.
Ctrl+, opens Settings in the new player.
manual_sweep.prior_build_check: Audio search result activation also reached Other before the final sizing-only change.

remaining_observations: Subtitles: ASS lane controls and Choose font action overflow the right edge; collapsed Auto Load leaves a large reserved gap.
Utilities: first cache row is implicitly centered and overlaps the history row; symbolic glyphs render poorly.
Advanced: config-directory input overlaps Choose button.
Key Bindings: fixed-width shortcut keycaps truncate Alt+RIGHT and Alt+LEFT; Windows labels mix platform symbols.
Plugins: refresh glyph is barely visible.
Control: first-mouse label lacks the other mouse rows' inset.
Audio/Network: remaining bare numeric fields lack the visible editable cells used elsewhere.
General reference has subsection links that are absent from Riina; Network reference uses a continuous page rather than isolated sections.
Preferences remains light even with Dark selected for playback; broader theme comparison is open.

full_desktop_evidence.result: Fullscreen video visible with controller. No persistent Riina surface after smoke exit. Interface window remains inside desktop; lower navigation is reachable by scrolling.
full_desktop_evidence.privacy: Raw images remain untracked; unrelated desktop content must not be published.
